description: The review gate and the affiliate front matter of itineraries and tips (D33, D37), as the site (src/lib/content.ts: zod schemas + isVisible + articleKey, front matter parsed by Astro's YAML parser) and the pipeline (src/escapadinha/articles.py: which articles get affiliate links) must both read them. Checked by web/test/content.test.ts and tests/test_affiliate_blocks.py. Each case is one MDX file's front matter (YAML text). error: the front matter is refused (the site build fails, the export raises), for the fields the pipeline reads (reviewed, fixture, affiliates); otherwise the case is valid for the site's schema. published: whether the entry is built from real data (site) and from fixture data (fixture_site). key: how affiliates.json names the article. affiliates: the programmes it lists.

cases.front_matter:

destination: ROM
days: 3
last_checked: 2026-10-14
